description: The financial readout for one project: the budget, per-domain renewal costs, total known carry, how many domains have unknown renewal costs, and remaining headroom. For questions about what a project costs to hold or how much budget is left. Domains held at another registrar renew at that registrar's prices, which are not visible here, so their cost is reported as unknown with reason foreign_registrar_pricing, never guessed and never zero. A transfer-in price, when shown, is not their renewal price. When partial is true, headroom is an upper bound. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
name: get_finance
